decision.observation: 6 mph, gear 1, timer 28:01.351, all dots pale, no red X. Car sits slightly left of the gravel centre, nose up-frame; the road curves gently left then right ahead between white posts, wide and clear.
decision.hypothesis: The stall converted cleanly and speed is climbing again from 0. With no immediate hazard and the road wide, plain throttle should build back toward 12-13 mph without losing the road.
decision.memory: From a full stall, the first plain-W second yields ~6 mph; a second second reaches ~10-12 before any edge drift appears — so the safe throttle window after a stall is two presses.
